lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Teacher.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Did anything interesting happen to you today?
Not really.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I see...
What about you?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Just an ordinary day for me as well.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Tia forgot her bow this morning,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: so I took out the spare one I had in my bag and tied it on her.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: At that point, I was just relieved that she had put on her stockings properly.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Her hair was also a mess, so I brushed it for her.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: With just a few gentle strokes, Tia's hair transformed into a velvety cascade.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: After entering the classroom, I checked her homework,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: and just like I thought, most of it was not done.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Can you believe it? She left 8 out of 10 questions unanswered!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Isn't she just adorable? Haha.
Absolutely adorable.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: You should have seen her face

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: when I asked her to complete the questions before the lesson began.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Then, she worked up a storm to get them all done.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I mean, it's something that can be done quickly, yet it always slips her mind.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: LOL

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Oh yes!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: And every time she sits down at her desk,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: she'd sink into her seat like a blob of jelly.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Although she insists that it's the most comfortable position for her,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I'm sure it's bad for her body if she doesn't have a good posture.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: That's why I'm always reprimanding her to sit up straight.
Wow, every single time? That's really impressive!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I also do it during my break time as a form of stretching. Hehe.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Here's another intriguing tidbit about Tia.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: When it comes to desserts, she's the most punctual person you'll ever meet,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: but whenever the lunch bell rings, she always acts like she can't hear it.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: So, I always end up

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: making sure she has her lunch every day.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Despite what she thinks, desserts are not a proper meal.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: However tempting they may be, they should not replace her regular meals.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: After all,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: we're students

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: and our growing bodies need proper nutrition.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Even if we are Nikkes. Hehe.
Exactly, so don't forget to eat three square meals a day.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I won't!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: it's almost time for me to pass Tia her sportswear.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Earlier, I noticed that

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: she had left them in her bag.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: While I'm at it, I should help her tie her hair as well.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Anyway, I'm off now!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Don't hesitate to send me a message if you have any exciting news to share!
Okay. See you later.
It seems like Naga's day revolves around Tia, rather than herself...
